explanation: This fires only at D1 in the last few trials of the episode (about trial 93 onward); it is 0 at every GO and D2 step and at every step before about trial 90. In those final trials D1 is high (8-10) when the previous trial was unrewarded and low to moderate (0-5) when it was rewarded, and the rewarded-case value climbs slowly toward the end of the episode, from about 1 near trial 94 to about 4-5 by trial 96-99.
